newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN WORKER DIES IN DIAMOND MINE ACCIDENT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN WORKER DIES IN DIAMOND MINE ACCIDENT.

text.p: One miner died and another was injured when a roof support failed on Thursday night at Messina Diamond Mine, the National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) said on Friday.
Messina Diamond Mine is a subsidiary of Messina Investments Ltd .

"The accident occurred as a result of roof support failure. If safety standards to be enforced under the new Mine Health and Safety Act were set, this type of accident could not have happened," the NUM said in a statement.
"The delay to stipulate safety standards will result in continuation of lack of control over health hazards and unnecessary loss of lives," it said.
